verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or an agent-connection endpoint. The available signals are an llms.txt file, ERP/HRIS/Excel integrations and in-product AI, none of which is an MCP server; probes also found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
